limitations: Three-repetition technical and natural workload screens are separate; do not select a peak as sustained performance.
Natural screens disable ignore_eos but cap output at 512; this is not full-answer semantic validation.
Cache history persists between requests; the first request starts from trained seeds, later requests are adaptive.
Different cache capacity/plan or workload can change CPU/GPU rounding and free-generation text.
Strict CPU-reference failures and the earlier quantitative-answer failure remain unresolved.
Scheduler submit/copy counters are host intervals, not isolated GPU elapsed time or measured PCIe bytes.
Initial uncached per-submit device-property profiling was invalid and is excluded from valid speed comparisons.
QKV aliasing was not active on GPT120B: each Q8_0 projection has 256-byte inter-tensor padding.
The QKV-alias candidate failed the isolated Qwen3 regression and was removed; its former flag is rejected.
Natural timings preceded removal of the unused QKV candidate; those measured profiles did not enable it. Final source was separately rescreened.
The original quantitative gate allowed 0.02 error, inconsistent with the requested rounded answer; this summary recomputes exact numeric equality and retains the original loose result.
Removing redundant post-copy fences did not establish an additional throughput gain.
Synthetic fixtures are untrained; a second trained larger-than-VRAM MoE remains untested.

tests.retained_flake: One oversized HTTP-body validation test raised BrokenPipeError on its first full run; the unchanged local-app target passed on one rerun.
